response.original_title: Dead Men Tell No Tales: The History of the Attraction
response.overview: This documentary gives us a look at the creation of the "Pirates" ride via archival materials and interviews with project director Bruce Gordon, Imagineering vice chairman Marty Sklar, senior vice president Tony Baxter, senior show writer Chris Goosman, executive vice president Tom Fitzgerald, and Imagineers Alice Davis, Harriet Burns, Blaine Gibson, Wayne Jackson, Francis X. Atencio, and Roger Broggie. The program goes through the attraction's genesis and completion and provides an entertaining and enjoyable tour.
response.title: Dead Men Tell No Tales: The History of the Attraction
